title: Technical SEO Triage
summary: Inspect a bounded site sample, identify supported technical SEO issues, and prioritize the few fixes most likely to change crawl, index, or page behavior.

required_inputs.description: The site URL or origin whose technical SEO state should be triaged.

scope.guidance: Inspect metadata for no more than ten representative pages in the bounded sample.

completion_without.limitation: The method cannot identify or compare the sampled pages reliably without page metadata.

evidence_plan.fallback: Narrow the sample if possible; otherwise return an incomplete diagnostic.

scope.guidance: Inspect technical signals for the same representative sample of no more than ten pages.

completion_without.limitation: The method cannot support technical issue findings without observable technical signals.

evidence_plan.fallback: Return an incomplete diagnostic rather than inferring site-wide technical state.

scope.guidance: Read only sampled pages needed to resolve structured-content or linking questions.

evidence_plan.condition: Use a full-page reader when static server evidence raises a material structured-content or internal-linking question that the server evidence does not resolve.

completion_without.limitation: Affected content and linking questions remain unknown and cannot become supported issues.

evidence_plan.fallback: Record the unresolved scope as unknown and omit recommendations that require page-content confirmation.

scope.guidance: Render only sampled pages needed to test a material client-rendering question.

evidence_plan.condition: Use rendered-page evidence when static signals suggest that client-side rendering may change crawlable content, metadata, or links.

completion_without.limitation: Rendered behavior remains unknown and cannot become a confirmed issue or unaffected finding.

evidence_plan.fallback: Record the rendering question as suspected or unknown and request a compatible rendered-page capability for confirmation.

scope.guidance: Use one user-supplied or independently authorized search-performance context for the sampled scope.

evidence_plan.condition: Use first-party evidence only when the user supplies it or authorizes an independent source and the requested finding depends on crawl, index, click, or other account state.

completion_without.limitation: The result cannot claim private crawl, index, or search-performance state.

evidence_plan.fallback: Limit the diagnostic to observable public signals and mark first-party checks unavailable.

steps.instruction: Define a representative, bounded URL sample from known site structure, user input, or available discovery evidence.
Inspect current runtime cost and authorization for the planned sample and provider-backed checks.
Inspect accessible status, redirect, canonical, metadata, structured, rendering, and linking signals that do not require broader paid checks.
Run only authorized provider checks that can confirm or reject a material issue in the sample.
Group observations into supported issues, suspected issues, unaffected scope, and unknown scope without extrapolating the sample to the full site.
Return the highest-value supported fixes with severity, confidence, affected sample, evidence, impact, owner, and verification method.

evidence_requirements: Every issue identifies the observed URL sample and evidence source.
Site-wide claims are made only when the evidence covers the full claimed scope.
Severity and impact are reasoned separately from confidence.
Verification methods state what observable change would confirm the fix.
stop_conditions: Stop or narrow the sample when broad crawling would exceed authorization or cost bounds.
Stop private-account diagnosis when no authorized first-party source is connected.
Return an empty completed diagnostic when the supported checks find no material issue.
completion_criteria: The inspected sample and its limits are explicit.
Each reported issue has severity, confidence, scope, evidence, intervention owner, and verification method.
The result contains no more than five prioritized fixes and may contain fewer when evidence does not support five.
Unknown and unaffected scope are not presented as fixed.

bounds.sample_guidance: Prefer a representative URL sample and three to five material fixes over an exhaustive crawl or a padded issue count.
